blocks.text: يوتن دونیا تشچیله ری برله شگزا

translations.en: One person has destroyed the world, the world is full of people.
The third month of the year

blocks.text: بلم مه کته بله ری ئوچن پر اگر امها

translations.en: I don't know, but I'm sure it's full of them.

blocks.text: س. س. س. ر. حالقلارينك ئوزه ك نه شريياتي مد سکه و - 1925 پل

translations.en: S. S. R. Halqalarink Oze Kne Shariati Mod Coin and - 1925 Bridge
